[Roundup] Evening library opening to expand... users highly satisfied
The city said that user satisfaction with the evening opening of public libraries, run as a pilot this year, was high. Most respondents answered that it is convenient because they can borrow books even after work. Based on these results, the city plans to add ten more evening-opening libraries next year.

entries.ko: '탄소 중립'이란 배출한 온실가스의 양과 흡수·제거한 양을 같게 만들어 순배출량을 영으로 하는 것을 말한다. 이는 배출을 완전히 없앤다는 뜻이 아니라, 줄이기 어려운 부분은 숲 조성이나 포집 기술로 상쇄한다는 뜻이다. 따라서 탄소 중립을 달성하려면 감축 노력과 상쇄 수단이 함께 필요하다.
entries.g: 'Carbon neutrality' means making the amount of greenhouse gas emitted equal to the amount absorbed or removed so that net emissions become zero. This does not mean eliminating emissions completely; it means offsetting the parts that are hard to reduce through forest creation or capture technology. Therefore, achieving carbon neutrality requires both reduction efforts and offsetting means.

read.true: 탄소 중립은 배출 감축과 상쇄를 함께 추진해야 달성할 수 있는 목표이다.
